messages:
Alex M.: Quick midweek capacity flag — marketing promo kicked off at 06:00 UTC and traffic is +28% overall. Seeing burn spikes and queue depth in eu-west (cluster-42) starting ~06:15, p95 latency creeping up. Can we triage short-term?
Maya R.: On it. Dashboards show sustained tail growth and increased KV cache churn. eu-west node pool is hitting autoscale ceiling.
Samir: We have ~8 spare A100s in us-west staging that can be moved as preemptible burst. Will take ~20m to attach and warm caches. Would prefer routing before moving large state.
Priya K.: Preemptible route is fastest but risk of evictions. If eviction rate >5% throughput drops and clients will see retries. Suggest: increase autoscale cap for eu-west from 120 -> 160 for 48h, add preemptible fallback in us-west, and enable faster fallback routing policy.
capacity-bot: Automated alert: eu-west cluster-42 GPU burn +40% vs baseline in last 30m, queue depth +110, p95 lat +220ms, network egress 86%. Incident score: medium.
Jordan: Network note — eu-west egress saturation is due to non-critical tenant backups + model checkpoint snapshots landing right now. That's amplifying the latency. If backups are paused we can recover ~15-20% headroom.
Alex M.: Maya — can you pause the non-urgent backups for 4h while we ride out the promo? Also please coordinate canary routing to us-west for stateless traffic.
Maya R.: Yep, pausing scheduled tenant backups for eu-west windows 07:00-11:00 UTC. Pushing routing rule change in 5m.
Samir: Opening a short-lived infra action: attaching 8xA100 preemptible to eu-west-burst pool and enabling prefix-cache warmup. Command I will run:
``` 
# attach preemptible nodes and drain staging
infractl attach-nodes --region eu-west --pool eu-west-burst --sku a100 --count 8 --preemptible
infractl warm-cache --cluster cluster-42 --prefixes top-200
```
Priya K.: Quick cost estimate: using preemptibles (~$0.9/hr per A100) for 8 units for 12 hours ~ $86/hr -> ~$1,032. If we instead scale reserved capacity (no preemptible) delta cost closer to $2.2k/day. Recommend preemptible + autoscale cap bump.
Alex M.: Good. For bookkeeping, add ticket INFRA-782 (attach burst A100s + warm caches) and COMMS-457 (pause backups + customer comms if needed).
Maya R.: COMMS — I'll ping Solutions to flag any noisy customers, but promo targets low-risk segments so should be fine.
Jordan: Long-term note: NICs on cluster-42 are 10G and showing high tx collisions at p95. Schedule NIC upgrade (25G) in next maintenance window to reduce egress bottleneck. I'll create INFRA-789 for NIC upgrade planning.
Samir: After attaching burst we should monitor eviction rate and effective throughput. If eviction > 7% we fallback routing to us-west permanently for progress-critical paths.
Priya K.: Running a quick projection table (rough numbers):
``` 
Region,Cluster,Current GPU hours/day,Projected peak GPU hours/day,Buffer needed (GPU hours)
us-west-2,cluster-17,720,780,60
eu-west,cluster-42,900,1180,280
apac-sg,cluster-9,610,720,110
```
Alex M.: Action items: 1) Samir attach 8xA100 preemptible (INFRA-782) 2) Maya pause backups + route rule (COMMS-457) 3) Priya monitor eviction/cost and adjust autoscale cap 4) Jordan plan NIC upgrade (INFRA-789). Aim to re-evaluate at 11:00 UTC.
Maya R.: Done on pause + routing rule pushed. Will post status at 07:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Samir: Kicked attach job, warming caches now. ETA 18m.
capacity-bot: Update: eu-west queue depth -36% since routing change and cache warmup started. Eviction rate 1.8% (preemptibles).
Priya K.: Cost update: projected incremental spend for the 12h window using preemptibles ~ $1.1k. If we need sustained reserved capacity we'll need OPEX signoff.
Alex M.: Thanks team. We'll meet back in the 11:00 check to confirm whether to return to normal autoscale caps or keep buffer for the weekend.
Jordan: Logging INFRA-789 now.
Maya R.: 07:31 UTC status: latency trending down, backups paused, no customer impact reported.
Samir: 07:34 UTC attach completed, caches warmed. Monitoring.
Priya K.: 07:50 UTC check — eviction stable, cost within estimate. Recommend closing INFRA-782 when we detach the preemptibles after 12h.
Alex M.: Closing loop: agreed. Re-evaluate at 11:00 and decide reserve vs scale strategy. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
